head: working-tree
subject: xDS certificate hash pinning
change: CertificateValidationContext.verify_certificate_hash is now decoded from SDS secrets and inline CDS transport sockets as hex SHA-256 pins. tls_material.Config carries the pins, Material copies them, installs a verifier even without SAN matchers, and after normal chain verification requires at least one peer-chain certificate to match a pin. The runtime SDS resolution copies validation pins into the cluster TLS override.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/tls_material.zig verifies matching and mismatching pins against the deterministic test certificate. src/grpc/xds/sds/secret_tests.zig covers hash decoding and invalid hex. src/grpc/xds/cds/tests.zig covers inline hash decoding. src/grpc/xds/runtime/sds_tests.zig asserts the resolved cluster carries the SDS pin.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='gRPC CDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC LDS' -Dtest-filter='LRS' -Dtest-filter='SDS' --summary all

full_library.notes: An earlier full run under host load 13-20 failed two HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 handshake timing cases; both passed in isolation and the rerun passed with no failures.

notes: Pins require trusted_ca and are additional to normal chain verification. Base64 SPKI pinning remains rejected. Hash-only validation contexts are not accepted yet.
